How many shares should you buy? The 1% rule 🧮

Capital ₹1,00,000 → risk 1% = ₹1,000.
Stop loss 5 points from entry.
Quantity = 1,000 ÷ 5 = 200.

Example only. Decide the stop first, then size the position.
